paper_id: OmniFuser_ Adaptive Multimodal Fusion for Service-Oriented Predictive Maintenance
title: OmniFuser: Adaptive Multimodal Fusion for Service-Oriented Predictive Maintenance
motivation: Unplanned tool failures cause quality degradation, downtime, and cost in manufacturing; current unimodal monitoring is insufficient.
problem_framing: Predictive maintenance as intelligent service requiring joint modeling of slow degradation trends and rapid operational dynamics from heterogeneous sensor streams and images.
key_insight: Contamination-free fusion requires explicitly disentangling shared and private representations with orthogonal decomposition, preserving modality-specific cues while enabling cross-modal interaction.
method_signature: C2F mechanism with shared/private separation, proxy-based cross-modal attention, and recursive refinement pathway anchoring fusion to original features.
evaluation_criteria: MSE/MAE for multi-step force forecasting; accuracy/precision for tool wear state classification across prediction horizons 12-96.
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Image-based methods heavily influenced by lighting variability and fail to capture dynamic changes in cutting process critical for early failure prediction.
evidence_for_taste: recursive refinement pathway functions as an anchor mechanism
contamination-free and information-sufficient basis for fusion
fails to resolve these slow variations
lacks persistent markers of cumulative wear
thinking_moves: 把融合问题重新定义为信息污染问题：交叉模态冗余导致私有信息丢失
通过正交分解形式化共享/私有分离，保证互信息下界不降低
用奇异谱分析(SSA)实证分解信号中的趋势vs残差能量分布，支撑低维趋势子空间假设
从服务工程角度反向设计模块化：每个组件设计为松耦合可复用服务模块
复杂度优化理论：二次复杂度O(T²d)压缩到线性O(Tkd)，以landmark近似主导交互子空间
